messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] sentinelbank (enterprise, dedicated pool sb-eu2-pool) p99 latency breach in eu2. p99=3.2s (SLO 2.0s). auto-created INC-20260317. paging @oncall-ryan @sre-ali

oncall-ryan: ack. joining.

oncall-ryan: looking at metrics — p95 ~900ms, p99 ~3.2s right now. overall CPU ~45% but a subset of GPUs showing high mem & kernel stalls.

sre-ali: pulling traces for sb-eu2-pool now. can someone paste the tail of the pool logs (last 1m)?

oncall-ryan: logs: ```
[6902468098] pool=sb-eu2-pool shard=3 tenant=sb-tenant-03 request_id=rr-78a WARN KVCache: eviction spike (size=12.1MB -> miss_rate=0.87)
[6902468099] pool=sb-eu2-pool shard=3 tenant=sb-tenant-03 request_id=rr-78b INFO seq_len=820 tokens served=820 latency=3120ms
[6902468100] pool=sb-eu2-pool shard=3 tenant=sb-tenant-03 request_id=rr-78c ERROR model-run timeout
```

eng-ryu: seeing huge KV cache eviction churn for tenant sb-tenant-03. cache hit dropped from ~98% to ~12% in the last 3m. that explains long tail latencies.

pm-julia: what is customer-visible? are they getting 5xx or just slow responses?

support-maya: SentinelBank reported intermittent timeouts on their internal search UI and slower batch-embedding jobs. A few failed user requests logged. They're on a business tier.

sre-ali: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) isolate the noisy tenant to an isolated slab with a lower concurrency cap 2) if needed, route their traffic to quantized smaller variant/throughput-optimized model 3) warm fallback region (eu1) if degradation continues.

oncall-ryan: performing isolation update now:```
$ redwood routes update --pool sb-eu2-pool --tenant sb-tenant-03 --max-concurrency 4 --route-target isolated-slab
Response: 202 Accepted - routing update queued (op_id=op-5591)
```

incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler detected load and added +2 workers to sb-eu2-pool (scale event id=scale-991).

eng-ryu: after route change, p99 down to ~1.3s within ~90s. other tenants' metrics normalized, KV cache miss rate for others back to ~95% hit.

support-maya: informing SentinelBank: "We've isolated the noisy workload and applied temporary throttles. We're seeing latency return to normal for other workloads. Working on durable fixes. Next update in 15m."

acct-sam: opening a high-touch support ticket + scheduling customer bridge for 15:05 UTC. I'll run the bridge link once calendar is confirmed.

pm-julia: ok long-term: investigate why tenant has huge sequence lengths and cache churn. consider per-tenant cache reservation or better pre-warming. Also evaluate token-rate limiting for large seqs.

sre-ali: preparing safe fallback plan (if p99 >2s again): switch tenant model to quantized throughput variant. running command now:```
$ redwood deploy set-version --tenant sb-tenant-03 --model sb-gpt-large --variant quant-8 --reason "emergency latency mitigation"
Response: applied. op_id=op-5592
```

eng-ryu: variant switch completed. immediate observed p99 ~980ms on the tenant requests. lower memory footprint and fewer kernel stalls.

oncall-ryan: monitoring — 15m stable window reached, no new 5xx. handing off monitoring to SRE for 2hr watch.

sre-ali: taking over incident watch. I'll collect traces and start RCA doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-20260317 (will update). tagging this thread #incident #sb-slo.

acct-sam: bridge invite sent to SentinelBank ops @15:05 UTC. I'll lead the customer update and provide notes on mitigations.

pm-julia: follow-ups: create ticket to evaluate per-tenant cache quotas, revisit autoscale thresholds for eu2, and add synthetic tests for long-sequence workloads.

support-maya: noted. sending summary to customer now. :thumbsup:

oncall-ryan: closing active paging. if anything spikes, re-open here or page oncall. thanks team.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for an enterprise customer latency war room; single-thread string with prefixed sender names per agents.md rules.
